articles.text:
2. How to say 'I'll call again'

When the person you want is not in, you may wish to leave a message. However, the contents of the message may be too complex to express in Japanese. In such a case, you may wish to say 'I'll call again' in Japanese, so that you can call at another time (or avoid possible difficulties in comprehending what the person on the line says). You can use the following expression for this purpose:

Mata odenwa shimasu.    I'll call again.
